scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run build -w @nexo-assist/shared -- --watch" "npm run dev -w @nexo-assist/api" "npm run dev -w @nexo-assist/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexo-assist/shared && npm run build -w @nexo-assist/api && npm run build -w @nexo-assist/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nexo-assist/shared && npm run test -w @nexo-assist/shared && npm run test -w @nexo-assist/api && npm run test -w @nexo-assist/web
